hooks.name: Untrusted text check
hooks.description: When browser code changes, make sure text from phones is never rendered as HTML.

action.prompt: Browser code changed. Search the edited file for innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML and document.write. Any value that came from a phone, a WebSocket message or a URL parameter must be rendered with textContent or DOM nodes, never as HTML. Also check that no motion control was added without a touch alternative (product steering). Fix any problem you find and say what you changed.
